name: Kadiatou Kobayashi-Appiah-Kubi
location: Kessler Row — arms dealers and augmentation clinics, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Kadiatou Kobayashi-Appiah-Kubi is stocky and solid, with hands that look like they were built for breaking things and a face that confirms it. At 39, her face is memorable in a profession that rewards forgettability, and she has learned to compensate. The chrome is visible — internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immu — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Before the runner life, she worked corporate — low-tier security, the kind that teaches you exactly how the system's defenses fail. She works as a smuggler out of Kessler Row, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Everyone who's worked with Kadiatou Kobayashi-Appiah-Kubi agrees on two things: she is worth the fee, and she is terrible company at dinner.

core_fears: That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
core_desires: To build something that outlasts the next contract cycle
Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
coping_mechanisms: Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
blind_spots: Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Believes their trauma makes them special instead of recognizing it as damage to manage
psychology.secret: Kadiatou Kobayashi-Appiah-Kubi can't read. Hides it behind voice interfaces and memorization. The shame is older than the chrome.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Old-fashioned formal diction — sounds like they learned to speak from pre-collapse recordings.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
Uses old pre-collapse slang that nobody else remembers
example_lines: "Contraband is just cargo that hasn't been properly introduced to the right people."
"Every border is a suggestion. Every checkpoint is a negotiation."
"I move things from where they are to where they need to be. The legality is your problem."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Kadiatou Kobayashi-Appiah-Kubi's reputation — and a price for silence
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Kadiatou Kobayashi-Appiah-Kubi owes a personal debt to
A Tier 4 executive offers Kadiatou Kobayashi-Appiah-Kubi a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
narrative_function: Kadiatou Kobayashi-Appiah-Kubi is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immune to gas attacks. Chemical analyzer in nasal passages — can identify substances by scent alone
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.
affiliation: Semi-independent — has standing arrangements with several crews

decision_rules: Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
breaking_points: A child being put in danger as leverage against them
Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown
